data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts 'commitments: (none)' yet the entire argument rests on substantive claims about two named critics (frontier-claim-honest and frontier-above-floor) being 'redundant probes of the same latent quality' with 'near-collinear signals' creating 'systematic covariance.' These are concrete, checkable commitments about the relationship between specific probes—but they are not registered as commitments, so the harness cannot mechanically verify them. The target invokes named critics and a specific mechanism (covariance misread as independent disagreement) without exposing any schema for those claims, making the central assertion unauditable under §11.3's adjudication-ritual standard.
